title: ARDS — Berlin Definition
keywords: not fully explained by cardiac failure
sources: ARDS Definition Task Force. JAMA 2012 (Berlin Definition); 2023 global definition update noted
purpose: Confirms the diagnosis of ARDS and grades severity by PaO2/FiO2. All four criteria (timing, imaging, origin of oedema, oxygenation on PEEP ≥ 5) must be met. Severity band drives the escalation ladder.

items.label: Timing — within 1 week of a known clinical insult or new/worsening respiratory symptoms
Chest imaging — bilateral opacities not fully explained by effusions, lobar/lung collapse, or nodules
Origin of oedema — respiratory failure not fully explained by cardiac failure or fluid overload (objective assessment e.g. echo if no risk factor present)
Oxygenation — PaO2/FiO2 with PEEP or CPAP ≥ 5 cmH2O

interpretation.label: Criteria incomplete — if timing, imaging, or origin is not met, this is not ARDS by the Berlin definition. Reassess the missing element (e.g. echo for cardiogenic oedema); a P/F > 300 on PEEP ≥ 5 also excludes it

MILD ARDS (P/F 201–300) — mortality ~ 27%. Lung-protective ventilation: VT 6 mL/kg PBW (4–8), Pplat ≤ 30, driving pressure < 15, adequate PEEP, conservative fluids, treat the cause. Consider HFNC/NIV only with close monitoring

MODERATE ARDS (P/F 101–200) — mortality ~ 32%. As above PLUS higher PEEP strategy, early prone positioning ≥ 16 h/day if P/F < 150, neuromuscular blockade for ventilator dyssynchrony/high drive, target SpO2 88–95%

SEVERE ARDS (P/F ≤ 100) — mortality ~ 45%. Prone positioning, NMB, high PEEP; consider recruitment cautiously (avoid routine aggressive RM — ART trial harm). Refer for VV-ECMO early (EOLIA criteria: P/F < 80 or pH < 7.25 with PaCO2 ≥ 60 for > 6 h despite optimisation)

notes: Use PBW from height, not actual weight. The 2023 global definition broadens ARDS to include HFNC ≥ 30 L/min and SpO2/FiO2 ratios (≤ 315) and permits diagnosis without invasive ventilation and with ultrasound imaging — check which definition your unit / study uses. P/F varies with FiO2 and PEEP — recheck after a standardised ventilator setting.
buildNote: All of timing+imaging+origin required (3 pts) plus an oxygenation band; total 4=mild, 5=moderate, 6=severe.
